about_the_game:
Lara is a young girl from Manaus who is taking a tour around the city with an old friend she had not seen in years. But what was meant to be a simple sightseeing activity unfolds into a dark spiral of mysteries and revelations.

During one of their tours, Lara realizes that her friend has disappeared. Amid the confusion, she finds in her bag an enigmatic letter, accompanied by the photograph of an abandoned building and an urgent call from her friend.

Overcome by fear but guided by affection and the desire to find her, Lara decides to follow the trail to the building. As she explores its corridors, she discovers that the place is inhabited by grotesque entities—manifestations of Amazonian myths and urban legends that have taken terrifying physical form.

With each step, Lara draws closer not only to the fate of her friend but also to her own deepest fears. The city, its shadows, and its forgotten stories become the stage for a journey where courage and fragility walk side by side.

Gameplay

In Do Not Disturb: Untold Tales, progression unfolds through a cycle of tension, discovery, and choice:

Escape and Survival: Learn patterns to evade or outwit enemies.

Exploration and Puzzles: Solve challenges to unlock new areas and uncover narrative secrets.

Demo:

• Included content: Prologue/Intro + a slice of Chapter 1.

• Estimated length: ~20–30 minutes (depends on exploration/puzzle solving).

• Available features: 2D exploration, basic stealth (evade/trick threats), item collection, puzzle solving.

• Not included in this demo: later chapters, achievements, advanced accessibility options, and any cutscenes.

• Progress: does not carry over to the full game.
